applicable_conditions: 淘汰方向与 LRU 相反
diagnosis: 淘汰时按使用计数取最大值，即淘汰了最近被访问最多的条目，与 LRU 语义相反。修复原则：最近最少使用淘汰应在使用计数最小的条目中选择牺牲者；get 命中后递增计数，put 也递增计数。
original_report: 会话缓存满了之后，被挤掉的是刚刷新过的那份会话，用户被迫重新登录。
patch_diff:
--- a/target.py
+++ b/target.py
@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@
         self._items[token] = payload
         self._hits[token] = self._hits.get(token, 0) + 1
         while len(self._items) > self.capacity:
-            victim = max(self._hits, key=lambda item: self._hits[item])
+            victim = min(self._hits, key=lambda item: self._hits[item])
             del self._items[victim]
             del self._hits[victim]
verification_tests:
from target import TokenCache


def test_least_recently_used_token_is_evicted():
    cache = TokenCache(capacity=2)
    cache.store("t1", "p1")
    cache.store("t2", "p2")
    cache.load("t1")
    cache.store("t3", "p3")
    assert cache.load("t2") is None
    assert cache.load("t1") == "p1"


def test_recently_used_token_survives():
    cache = TokenCache(capacity=2)
    cache.store("t1", "p1")
    cache.store("t2", "p2")
    cache.load("t1")
    cache.store("t3", "p3")
    assert cache.load("t1") == "p1"


def test_missing_token_returns_none():
    cache = TokenCache(capacity=2)
    assert cache.load("none") is None
